prompt: How do I find rankings for ECNL, NAL, and MLS Next teams in the same view?
response_text:
Here are some tools & tips for seeing rankings (or standings) across ECNL, MLS NEXT, and NAL in the same view — plus what you *can’t* easily find, and why.

---

## 🔍 What ECNL, MLS NEXT, and NAL are

- **ECNL (Elite Clubs National League)** — one of the premier youth leagues in the U.S., with separate ECNL and ECNL RL (Regional League) tiers. Strong exposure & competition. ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elite_Clubs_National_League?utm_source=openai))  
- **MLS NEXT** — MLS’ academy system. It has divisions like “Academy”, “Homegrown”, etc. ([leaguetables.soccer](https://leaguetables.soccer/?utm_source=openai))  
- **NAL (National Academy League)** — usually considered just below ECNL and MLS NEXT in terms of visibility and competition level, though some NAL teams or divisions may overlap in quality. ([reddit.com](https://www.reddit.com/r/youthsoccer/comments/1kqk2yq/alphabet_soup_confusion_ecnl_sscl_nal_mls_next/?utm_source=openai))  

---

## 🛠 Tools that let you view multiple leagues together

Here are a few sites/apps that let you compare teams or view rankings/standings across ECNL + MLS NEXT — some include NAL or allow you to input NAL teams manually.

| Tool | What you can see together | What is missing or limited |
|------|----------------------------|-----------------------------|
| **Through Ball** | ECNL, ECNL RL, and MLS NEXT conferences + age groups; standings/tables, results, next matches, also national rankings. ([throughball.net](https://throughball.net/?utm_source=openai)) | Doesn’t seem to reliably include full NAL standings. Focus is on ECNL + MLS NEXT. |
| **MyLeagueRankings** | Many teams across leagues (including ECNL & MLS NEXT) with power standings. ([myleaguerankings.com](https://myleaguerankings.com/teams/?utm_source=openai)) | NAL is less visible; depends on teams uploading results. It’s unofficial. |
| **Youth Soccer Index™** | Clubs in ECNL & MLS NEXT; club-level ranking and performance across age groups. ([youthsoccerindex.com](https://youthsoccerindex.com/?utm_source=openai)) | NAL inclusion is spotty. Some data gaps depending on region. |
| **Table & Pitch** | Standings, schedules, and complete conference tables for ECNL Boys/Girls, ECNL RL, MLS NEXT Academy & Homegrown. ([tableandpitch.com](https://tableandpitch.com/?utm_source=openai)) | Does not explicitly show “NAL” as a separate league. It focuses on ECNL / MLS NEXT. |
| **USYS Rankings** | “National table” rankings combining ECNL & MLS NEXT teams across age groups (e.g., U16 Boys). ([usysrankings.com](https://usysrankings.com/?utm_source=openai)) | NAL not specifically called out; might be rolled into “National” if teams participate. |

---

## ⚠ Gaps & things that are hard to compare reliably

- **NAL transparency** — NAL standings are harder to find and less consistently aggregated. Some sites don’t include NAL or treat it differently.  
- **Data permission** — ECNL and some Girls Academy results/standings may not be allowed to be reproduced outside their official domains. Example: AthleMix must link to ECNL / Girls Academy official pages rather than hosting the data itself. ([athlemix.com](https://athlemix.com/youth?utm_source=openai))  
- **Different competition formats & schedules** — ECNL, MLS NEXT, and NAL often have very different league structures, postseason formats, and schedules, which can make direct ranking comparisons misleading.  
- **Incomplete overlapping games** — Teams may not play inter-league or inter-division games, so head-to-head comparisons are often missing.  
- **Unofficial vs official data** — Many combined rankings are done by third-party sites using proprietary models; not all leagues endorse them.

---

## ✔ Best ways to get what you want

To see rankings across ECNL, MLS NEXT, *and* NAL in one place:

1. **Use Through Ball** and **Youth Soccer Index** together — check if they include your NAL team(s).  
2. **USYS Rankings National Table** — if your team is ECNL or MLS NEXT, it’ll likely be there. If NAL, check if NAL results upload to national tables.  
3. **Search by team names** on sites like Table & Pitch, MyLeagueRankings, Youth Soccer Index — you can often see where a team ranks relative to others if its league participates.  
4. **Contact your club** — sometimes they publish their ranking in NAL (if that’s the league they’re in) and their equivalents in ECNL/MLS NEXT or show comparative performance across showcases.  
5. **Use local/regional ranking tools**, like PitchRank, for your state or region — they sometimes combine ECNL, MLS NEXT, NAL, etc. Example: NJ’s U18 rankings include ECNL, NAL, and MLS Next teams. ([pitchrank.io](https://www.pitchrank.io/rankings/nj/u18/male?utm_source=openai))

---
